subject.title: 一个现实的问题，很多人将面临无法访问github

question: Should this be treated as off-topic external-service promotion, or should maintainers ask the reporter to restate it as a scoped ClawHub access/auth problem?
rationale: The only concrete content is a VPN referral link, while any interpretation involving non-GitHub auth or regional access changes would alter the product/auth boundary and cannot be inferred from the report.

options.title: Treat as off-topic promotion
options.body: Handle this through human moderation/support triage and avoid starting source work from the current report.

options.title: Ask for a scoped reproduction
options.body: Request a ClawHub command or page, environment, expected and actual behavior, and sanitized logs before any code issue remains actionable.

options.title: Spin out an auth/access product issue
options.body: If maintainers want non-GitHub auth or mirrored access, create a separate product issue that defines the supported web and CLI behavior.

recommendation.title: Treat as off-topic promotion
recommendation.body: Handle this through human moderation/support triage and avoid starting source work from the current report.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the strongest current routing signal for the inspected auth and CLI access surfaces on current main.
